sample_result.qualification: 20 statement sample is separate from the targeted43 region-description audit and packed DATA audit.

binary_structure.scalar_note: 32 eight-byte scalar records occupy $2800-$28FF. Four seven-byte extended records begin at $2900, $2907, $290E, and $2915, ending at $291B. The original $96 reset sentinels become zero values with type 1; forced integer/string types are preserved by $2281.
binary_structure.array_note: The original PRG has $81 fill throughout $2DA2-$330B; startup $2281 clears that interval. Prefer "array storage, cleared at startup". Initializer $330C copies 0B 00 00 to $2F1C; $3311 copies 18 00 00 to $3206; record $3316 terminates because its third byte is $64.

probes.evidence_scope: offline synthetic original-runtime execution; archived editor-menu.vsf provides initialized RAM only, not a new live observation

live_replay_preparations.name: Portal overwrite in the complete placement path
live_replay_preparations.scalar_format: For integer Vn, record=$2800+8*n: high byte at +2, low byte at +3, type 1 at +6. All indices below are short scalars.
live_replay_preparations.memory: Set $C400-$C76F to 32. Destination p=$C598. Place glyph 91 in one tested cell: $C56F (p-41), $C570 (p-40), $C571 (p-39), $C597 (p-1), $C598 (center), or $C599 (p+1). Set the portal color array element at $32E0 to packed numeric 14: 00 00 0E 00 00.
live_replay_preparations.stop: At native $092C, when $39/$3A=$4B64, before polling another input.
live_replay_preparations.expected: At p-41, 91 becomes 104; at p-40, 91 becomes 105. At p-39, p-1, center, or p+1, the obstacle stays 91 and placement rejects. With all blank cells, the five portal components appear at offsets -41,-40,-39,-1,+1. This establishes synthetic-state behavior, not legal-input reachability.

live_replay_preparations.name: Numeric minus rejection predicate
live_replay_preparations.scalar: Write the test ASCII/PETSCII value to V0: high byte at $2802, low byte at $2803, type 1 at $2806.
live_replay_preparations.expected: Minus is rejected. This enters after GET/ASC and tests the filter. The offline full GET test starts at $48B6 and supplies -1 plus RETURN through GETIN; it returns V0=1, V5=0.
